answer: As of December 31, 2022, American Express Company did not have any debt securities registered to trade on a national securities exchange under its name pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act. Its only class of securities registered under Section 12(b) was its Common Shares (par value $0.20 per share), which traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol AXP.
rationale: The SEC Form 10-K cover page for FY2022 lists all classes of securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act, which only includes Common Shares (par value $0.20 per share), and no debt securities are listed.
